name: In the INTEREST OF: T.J.-A. Juvenile Officer, Respondent, v. T.A., Appellant.

court.name: Missouri Court of Appeals, Western District

opinions.text:
PER CURIAM:
T.A. appeals the trial court's judgment terminating his parental rights to his minor child, T.J.-A. Finding no error, we affirm. Because a published opinion would have no precedential value, a memorandum of law has been provided to the parties. Rule 84.16(b).
opinions.author: PER CURIAM:

attorneys: Edward E. Moore, Kansas City, for Respondent.
Mitchell J. Widener, Co-counsel for Respondent.
